name: Brilliant Minds
description: A rare condition — face blindness — gives an eccentric yet incredibly gifted neurologist a unique perspective on care, fueling his mission to change the way people see his patients. Alongside a team of brilliant young interns, he solves some of the world's most puzzling psychological cases while navigating the complicated relationships that come with the job.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Dr. Oliver Wolf reluctantly accepts a job at Bronx General Hospital where he's forced to work with a team of interns as they treat a mother who can no longer recognize her children.

videos.title: The Disembodied Woman
videos.overview: When a high school girls' basketball coach faces a debilitating illness, Dr. Wolf must help her reconnect with her body before it's too late. Ericka and Dana treat a frat boy who sees dragons.

videos.title: The Lost Biker
videos.overview: A member of a biker gang seeks out Dr. Wolf's help as he grapples with life-threatening memory loss. The interns are tasked to help a young girl struggling with mysterious seizures.

videos.title: The Blackout Bride
videos.overview: When a bloody bride stumbles into Bronx General, Wolf races against the clock to save her and her missing husband. Ericka and Jacob fight to keep a John Doe patient in their care.

videos.title: The Haunted Marine
videos.overview: Wolf must help a Marine grapple with mysterious symptoms before the birth of his child.

videos.title: The Girl Who Cried Pregnant
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf and the interns go back to high school to treat a group of pregnant teenagers.

videos.title: The Man from Grozny
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf and the team perform their most experimental treatment yet: a brain-computer interface implantation in their John Doe patient's brain.

videos.title: The Lovesick Widow
videos.overview: When an elderly woman is brought in with signs of dementia, Dr. Wolf investigates whether she's suffering from a neurological disorder or having a late-in-life awakening. Dr. Pierce grapples with a chilling discovery about one of her patients.

videos.title: The Colorblind Painter
videos.overview: When an artist refuses to paint for his upcoming show, Dr. Wolf and his team must figure out why. Dr. Pierce goes into uncharted territory with a patient.

videos.title: The First Responder
videos.overview: An unexpected patient crashes into Bronx General with mysterious life-threatening symptoms.

videos.title: The Other Woman
videos.overview: Dr. Pierce treats a patient in crisis, presenting an ethical dilemma. Dr. Wolf and Dr. Nichols disagree on how to treat a patient.

videos.title: The Doctor Whose World Collapsed
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf and his team face their biggest challenge yet when an apartment building collapses in the Bronx.

videos.title: The Man Who Can't See Faces
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf meets a pastor dealing with mysterious visions. The interns grapple with the fallout from the building collapse.

videos.title: The Phantom Hook
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf helps an MMA fighter with mysterious symptoms. Dr. Pierce considers a career outside of Bronx General.

videos.title: The Contestant
videos.overview: A reality show contestant lands at the hospital with an unusual delusion. Dr. Pierce fights for her future at Bronx General.

videos.title: The Pusher
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf and his team treat a young patient accused of a serious crime.

videos.title: Lady Liberty
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf and Dr. Pierce are tasked with a house call to evaluate a woman under a conservatorship. Dr. Kinney's curiosity is piqued by a patient outside the hospital.

videos.title: Once Upon a Time in America
videos.overview: When two patients arrive in critical condition, Dr. Wolf and Dr. Nichols must do whatever it takes to keep them alive.

videos.title: The Doctor's Graveyard
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf is haunted by a ghost from his past. A patient arrives at Bronx General who appears to have risen from the dead.

videos.title: The One That Got Away
videos.overview: A blast from the past shakes up Dr. Wolf's world when he becomes his next patient.

videos.title: The Upside Down
videos.overview: On a flight gone wrong, one patient's life is literally turned upside down.

videos.title: The Fire Fighter
videos.overview: Wolf treats a heroic firefighter who struggles to share his ALS diagnosis with his family.

videos.title: The Resident
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf helps a ballerina recover after a mystery illness; the team tries to save Sam's life and get him on the transplant list; secrets are revealed at the hospital's annual holiday gala that change the course of the doctors' lives.

videos.title: The Boy Who Feels Everything
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf and the team come together as one of their own fights for their life.

videos.title: The Rider
videos.overview: A rugged cowboy struts into Bronx General with mysterious symptoms and brings the rodeo with him; Dr. Wolf develops a relationship with someone who has ties to his father.

videos.title: The Rabbit Hole
videos.overview: When a college student comes in with a life-threatening illness, Dr. Wolf and his team have to get acquainted with sorority life. Dr. Thorne treats a child who collapsed under mysterious circumstances.

videos.title: The Invisible Man
videos.overview: A grisly accident puts everyone at Bronx General in danger and leads to a shocking revelation about Dr. Wolf.

videos.title: The Missing Person
videos.overview: A Party Girl, who's on the run, is rushed into the hospital and our doctors have to figure out what exactly she's running from. When Wolf doesn't show up for his shift at the hospital, Carol-- worried about his mental health-- goes on a mission to find him.

videos.title: Senses
videos.overview: Wolf grapples with being a psych patient at Hudson Oaks and has a startling revelation. A renowned chef comes into Bronx General after a harrowing accident at his restaurant.

videos.title: Doctor, Interrupted
videos.overview: Wolf becomes fascinated with an unusual patient at Hudson Oaks, who displays signs of being possessed. Carol and Thorne help newlyweds who are struggling with their sex life.

videos.title: Through the Looking Glass
videos.overview: On his first day back at Bronx General, Wolf treats an ex-con who has a medical emergency during a hostage situation; Ericka and Charlie care for a newborn baby in the midst of a life-threatening illness.

videos.title: The Hero's Journey
videos.overview: Wolf treats an anxious teen boy who's faced with a terrifying procedure: awake brain surgery. Carol and Dana investigate possible corruption at Hudson Oaks.

videos.title: The Way Home
videos.overview: Wolf and Josh’s relationship is tested when they tackle a case that hits close to home. Carol and Thorne deal with their own medical mystery: a patient harboring a huge secret. Van returns and helps Ericka and Dana through their own personal crises.
